observations: Large office printer wrapped in clear plastic film.
A stack of paper with 'Fancy' and 'KENDO ENTERPRISES' branding is visible on top.
The printer has three drawers at the bottom.
The unit is located in a cluttered environment with other office equipment visible.
No brand name, model number, or technical specification plate is legible in the photo.

claims.evidence: No Sharp branding or 3140 model number is visible on the unit in photo 0.

claims.claim: Low page count, under 20,000 copies. New drum and toner just fitted, no paper jam.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The printer may not power on or may have internal mechanical faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on and completing a self-test.

risks.risk: The machine may be a different brand or model than the 3140 series.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's specification plate.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic large office printer of unknown model

risks.risk: The internal components (drum and toner) may be used or missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the printer's internal components or a receipt showing a recent replacement.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a full internal replacement

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the specification plate (usually on the back or side) to confirm the model.
Video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
Photo of the internal drum and toner area.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
